answer_text:
A great vegetarian “guest dinner” is **Mushroom & Lentil Wellington**: it feels special, slices beautifully, and you can do most of the work ahead.

## Mushroom & Lentil Wellington (serves 6)
**Time:** ~75–90 min (mostly hands-off)  
**Best with:** a crisp green salad or roasted asparagus

### Ingredients
- 2 tbsp olive oil + a little more for brushing
- 1 large yellow onion, finely chopped
- 3–4 garlic cloves, minced
- 1 lb (450 g) cremini mushrooms, finely chopped (or pulse in a food processor)
- 2 tbsp tomato paste
- 1 tbsp soy sauce or tamari
- 1 tsp smoked paprika
- 1 tsp dried thyme (or 1 tbsp fresh)
- 1/2 cup walnuts or pecans, finely chopped (optional but great)
- 1 1/2 cups cooked brown/green lentils (well-drained; from ~3/4 cup dry)
- 2–3 tbsp breadcrumbs or panko (as needed)
- 1/4 cup chopped parsley
- Salt + black pepper
- 1 sheet puff pastry, thawed (vegan if needed)
- 1 egg beaten for wash **or** 2 tbsp plant milk + 1 tsp maple syrup (vegan wash)

### Instructions
1. **Oven:** Heat to **400°F (205°C)**. Line a baking sheet with parchment.
2. **Make the filling:**  
   - Sauté onion in olive oil with a pinch of salt, 5–7 min.  
   - Add garlic, 30 sec.  
   - Add mushrooms and cook until they release liquid and it mostly evaporates, 10–15 min (this step prevents a soggy Wellington).  
   - Stir in tomato paste, soy sauce, paprika, thyme; cook 1–2 min.  
   - Off heat, mix in nuts (if using), lentils, parsley. Add breadcrumbs until the mixture holds together when pressed. Season well.
3. **Assemble:**  
   - Roll puff pastry on a floured surface into a rectangle.  
   - Mound filling in a tight log down the center, leaving a border.  
   - Fold pastry over, seal seam and ends, and place seam-side down on the tray.
4. **Finish:** Brush with egg wash (or vegan wash). Score a few shallow slits on top.
5. **Bake:** 30–40 min, until deeply golden. Rest 10 min, then slice.

### Make-ahead + hosting tips
- **Filling:** make up to **2 days ahead**; keep chilled.  
- **Assembled Wellington:** can be assembled earlier the same day and refrigerated; bake just before guests arrive.
- If you want a sauce: a quick **red wine mushroom gravy** or even a **store-bought vegetarian demi-glace** works nicely.

If you tell me **any allergies** (nuts/gluten/eggs), whether you want it **vegan**, and what **sides** you’re thinking, I can tailor it and suggest a full menu.
